triggers.detailsText: 1 crore = 10 million Refer to Annexure for Details of Instruments & Bank Facilities Detailed Rationale Crisil Ratings has upgraded its rating on the long-term bank facilities of Juniper Green Energy Limited (JGEL) to ‘Crisil AA-/Stable’ from ‘Crisil A+/Stable’. The rating upgrade factors in a healthy growth in the group’s operational capacity, timely execution track record of sizeable projects and the healthy financial position supported by comfortable debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) and recent equity raise of Rs 1,800 crore through initial public offer (IPO) in August 2026. In terms of operating performance, with commissioning of the capacities, the operating earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) increased to Rs 574 crore during the first half of fiscal 2027 from Rs 254 crore in the first half of fiscal 2026.

While his former colleague Zaheer Khan will strategise, plan and manage the outfit as its newly appointed head coach, Dhoni will do Dhoni things — keep his door always open for a chat, offer a comforting shoulder to cry on, crack a silly joke to lighten the mood and whisper an invaluable nugget of insight that will make a player better.
